newsitem.title: USA: Georgia Gulf Corp to record Q3 $8 mln gain.
newsitem.headline: Georgia Gulf Corp to record Q3 $8 mln gain.

text.p: Georgia Gulf Corp said Monday it expects to record a gain of about $8.0 million in its third quarter from the sale of the assets of its Great River Oil & Gas Corp subsidiary.
Net proceeds from this sale, received in July, were about $17 million.
The company said the operating results for this subsidiary have not historically been material to its financial statements.

In addition, the company said it hopes future profits and savings from its phenol/acetone expansion and co-generation facility, together with some strengthening in the aromatics market, will lead to improved results for the third quarter.
The company said it will be able to add 60 million pounds of phenol and 38 million pounds of acetone under favorable market conditions with the phenol/acetone expansion.
It also said the co-generation facility is fully operational as of the third quarter, and is supplying all its electicity and steam requirements.
The company reported earnings per share for the second quarter of $0.60 compared to $0.52 for the same period a year ago.
